choices.why: It is a sober double-pedestal desk in dark black-brown wood that matches the dark floor, and at 155 cm it gives a real workspace centered under the small window.
It is an all-black swivel chair with a molded ergonomic seat and a clean, modern line that fits the palette you asked for.
It is the only option in medium-dark wood that stays low against the left wall, so the room keeps its light and openness.
This articulated work lamp in glossy black matches the chair and gives good, adjustable light for working.
It is a compact leather armchair on a dark bentwood frame, ideal for reading in the corner by the tall window.

answer.why: The dark wood of the desk, bookcase and armchair frame continues the floor's tone, while the black chair and lamp add a modern, sober contrast against the white walls. The leather armchair brings warmth to the reading corner.
